Video games played on a mobile phone

Going to church on Sunday

options.misconception: Abuse usually stops on its own if the child stays quiet.

options.misconception: Child abuse should be left private and not discussed with others.

Letting elders decide without asking the children

Rinse cabbage in a bucket used to wash shoes
options.misconception: Believes water used for other things is fine for washing food.

Keep nails long and let hair stay untidy each day

options.misconception: Believes any covering on the foot gives full protection.

runs.sub_strand: 3.1 Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County

proposed.question: Which of these is an aspect of traditional culture in our county?

options.text: Festivals and ceremonies
Mobile phone networks
options.misconception: Believes culture only means modern technology that people use every day.

options.text: Electric power cables
options.misconception: Believes anything powered by electricity or machines is part of culture.

options.text: Modern office computers
options.misconception: Believes culture is only about work tools used in offices.

proposed.rationale: Festivals and ceremonies are listed in the curriculum as aspects of traditional culture in the county.
proposed.excerpt: dressing, food, housing, artefacts, sports and games, festivals and ceremonies

proposed.question: Which of these is an artefact?

options.text: A television set for the living room
options.misconception: Believes any household object counts as an artefact, even modern ones.

options.text: A school timetable pinned on a wall
options.misconception: Believes an artefact is any paper or notice used at school.

options.text: A carved wooden stool used by elders
A bag of maize flour from a shop

proposed.excerpt: identify aspects of traditional culture in the County

proposed.question: Which statement best describes traditional dressing in our county?

options.text: Clothes that are only worn to school each day

options.text: Clothes that show a community's colours, styles and history
Clothes that are the same in every country

options.text: Clothes that are bought only from big city shops
options.misconception: Believes traditional dress must be bought from shops rather than made locally.

proposed.excerpt: describe aspects of traditional culture in the County

proposed.question: Why is traditional culture important in our county?

options.text: It lets people forget old ways and use only new ones.

options.text: It is only useful to tourists who visit the county.
options.misconception: Believes culture matters only for money earned from visitors.

options.misconception: Believes culture is only for elderly people and not for the young.

proposed.excerpt: discuss the importance of traditional culture in the County

proposed.question: A class wants to show traditional culture in a display. Which item should they choose?

A poster of a foreign pop singer

options.text: A picture of a busy modern city
options.misconception: Believes culture is shown by modern cities rather than local traditions.

options.text: A printout of a supermarket price list
options.misconception: Believes any everyday item from shops shows traditional culture.

proposed.excerpt: collect and record aspects of traditional culture in the community.

proposed.question: Which of these is a form of child abuse?

Asking children to help fetch water

Singing traditional songs at weddings

proposed.excerpt: identify cultural practices that are harmful to children
